title: Arena
description: Arena / PvP mechanics, rewards and reset timing.

entries.name: Arena tickets (entry currency)
entries.summary: Arena does NOT consume stamina — it uses Arena tickets. Tickets renew daily and extra ones can be bought with gems at a steeply scaling cost. The 'fight Arena 5x' daily mission is designed around the 5 free tickets.

details.extra_with_gems: Up to 5 more per day, purchased with gems.
details.stamina: Arena uses NO stamina (unlike wilderness beasts/terrors). See knowledge/exploration.json -> stamina-refund-on-loss.

open_questions: Arena matchmaking/ranking rewards and reset timing.
Whether buying extra Arena tickets is ever worth the gem cost (likely a player decision; see gem-spending-priority).
